tax_free_note: Important: since January 2021 the UK has ended VAT-free shopping for departing passengers. You no longer get a VAT refund on items bought in the UK. However, 'duty-free' alcohol and tobacco prices still apply if you're flying outside the UK (these have separate excise duty exemptions).
hours_note: Most restaurants and shops at Heathrow open from 04:30 or 05:00 and close around 22:00. Some 24-hour options are available at T5.
